scope: Contract divergence between KDSOrderDetailsResource, KDSOrderItemsResource, OrderItemResource + allergen aggregation logic across multi-items
method: read-only static analysis of 3 resources + controller + service + Vue consumers

findings.title: KDSOrderItemsResource silently omits allergens_snapshot — items-board contract drift from OrderItemResource (food-safety field, not exposed on items board)
findings.consequence: Two divergent KDS payload shapes for the same chef-facing surface. Today's-orders cards see allergens (via OrderItemResource); items-board column (via KDSOrderItemsResource) does not. A chef relying on items-board column for prep batching never sees per-line allergens. Service-layer aggregation already splits items by allergen-hash (KitchenDisplaySystemOrderService:310) — the data exists in the merged row but is dropped at serialization. The items-board template (KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:124-160) does not currently render allergens, so user-visible regression is latent; food-safety risk emerges if any future Vue template iteration uses the kdsCustomization renderItem() helper (which requires allergens_snapshot to set hasAllergen).

findings.title: Three serializers for the same domain object — no shared base class, drift risk on every contract change

evidence.kds_details_resource: wraps Order → embeds OrderItemResource::collection for items
evidence.kds_items_resource: standalone OrderItem serializer (different field shape from OrderItemResource)
evidence.order_item_resource: canonical OrderItem serializer with composition_snapshot priority + allergens

findings.consequence: Adding a new contract field requires touching 2 resources. Symmetric drift is invisible to PHPUnit unless test fixtures assert both shapes. Z-1 finding is the canonical example — allergens_snapshot was added to OrderItemResource months ago without sister update to KDSOrderItemsResource. V1.0.X candidate refactor: extract a shared trait or have KDSOrderItemsResource delegate the per-line shape to a thin subset of OrderItemResource.

findings.title: Items-board groupBy hash mixes JSON-encoded scalars with sha1 (cross-line determinism risk on edge data)

evidence.code: $mergedItems = $allItems->groupBy(function ($item) { ... return json_encode([item_id, item_variations, item_extras, item_addons, instruction, allergens_hash]); })

findings.consequence: The hash key is plain json_encode of a struct that itself contains pre-encoded JSON sub-strings for variations/extras, raw addon JSON, lowercased trimmed instruction, AND a sha1 of allergens. Mixing encoding levels (json-inside-json + sha1) means: (a) any unicode/escaping inconsistency in legacy data flips the merge key silently; (b) per-row debugging across versions is hard. Function works today (sentinel tests pass for the documented shapes) but is a source of future regression if any of those sub-encoders change. Not a P0 — sentinel coverage exists at KdsAllergenAggregationSplitTest. Architectural note: prefer a single canonical normalize() helper that returns a flat array of stringly-typed components, then sha1 the whole thing.

findings.title: OrderItemResource ships BOTH composition_snapshot (full) AND derived item_variations/item_extras/item_addons — payload triple-encodes same data
findings.consequence: Wire payload size 2-3x larger than necessary for KDS use-case. Frontend (KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue + kdsCustomization.js) prefers composition_snapshot.lines/extras/addons over flat fields (per readVariations() priority). Cleanup candidate V1.0.X: gate the legacy flat fields behind a query param, or remove them once all clients use composition_snapshot. Not blocking — no functional bug, just bandwidth.

findings.title: KDSOrderDetailsResource correctly minimizes customer.phone for non-DELIVERY (Sprint 5A Z9-P0-03) — customer.name still ships unconditionally

evidence.current_logic: name shipped always; phone shipped only when order_type=DELIVERY

findings.consequence: Out-of-scope per task brief (owner-decision V1.0.X). Documented for completeness. Recommendation if owner gates Yes: gate name with same isDeliveryOrder predicate, OR redact to first-name-only for dine-in/takeaway/kiosk surfaces. Risk model: KDS WebSocket subscribers are all branch staff with permission:kitchen-display-system — not an external leak, but data-minimization principle still applies.

verdict.summary: Contract drift between KDS-items-board (KDSOrderItemsResource) and KDS-cards (KDSOrderDetailsResource → OrderItemResource) is real and confirms Z-1 finding. Heal is one field addition + sentinel test. Three serializers without a shared base class is a V1.0.X refactor candidate, not a V1 blocker. Items-board template doesn't currently render allergens, so user-visible regression is latent — but service-layer allergen-hash aggregation depends on the column being present on the model (it is, via cast).
verdict.heal_scope: 1-line addition to KDSOrderItemsResource::toArray + new sentinel test + verify admin-kds.js bundle (no rebuild required — items-board template doesn't read the field today)
